cluster_summary: This cluster contains vulnerabilities where user-supplied URLs or redirect targets are used in server-side network operations (redirects, HTTP requests, OS commands, DNS) without proper validation, allowing attackers to redirect users to malicious sites, perform SSRF, leak credentials, or execute commands.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled webhook URLs, callback URLs, endpoint parameters, or request destinations into outbound HTTP clients, URL.openConnection, fetch helpers, proxy clients, or webhook dispatchers. Report code paths where scheme, host, redirect target, DNS resolution, and private-address ranges are not constrained before the outbound request. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 21 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should enforce scheme and host allowlists, block private and metadata addresses after DNS resolution, and validate redirect targets.

mechanism.missing_guard: scheme, host, redirect target, DNS resolution, and private-address ranges are not constrained before the outbound request
mechanism.name: attacker-controlled webhook or callback URL fetch
mechanism.sink_shape: outbound HTTP clients, URL.openConnection, fetch helpers, proxy clients, or webhook dispatchers
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled webhook URLs, callback URLs, endpoint parameters, or request destinations
mechanism.typical_fix: enforce scheme and host allowlists, block private and metadata addresses after DNS resolution, and validate redirect targets

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Add destination validation (domain allow-list, scheme restriction, IP range blocking) or replace with controlled paths.
sub_patterns.name: SSRF due to missing destination validation in server-side HTTP clients
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-supplied URL is used directly in an outgoing HTTP request without any allow-list or block-list for hosts, schemes, or IPs.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Validate all URLs before passing to conversion library, restrict protocols, and block internal addresses.
sub_patterns.name: SSRF in document conversion pipelines via unvalidated embedded URLs
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-supplied document content (HTML, Markdown) contains URLs that are fetched by the conversion library without validation, allowing SSRF.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Expand denylist to include all known internal/cloud metadata IP ranges and address types.
sub_patterns.name: SSRF due to incomplete IP address denylist
sub_patterns.root_cause: The IP blocklist omits certain internal addresses (link-local, cloud metadata) allowing SSRF to those endpoints.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Restrict use of authenticated client to known internal hosts only; use a separate client for external requests.
sub_patterns.name: Credential leakage via authenticated HTTP client used for external destinations
sub_patterns.root_cause: A pre-authenticated HTTP client is reused for user-supplied URLs without verifying the destination is internal, leaking credentials.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Only enable trust-all when explicitly set; otherwise use default JVM trust store.
sub_patterns.name: SSL/TLS certificate validation disabled by default
sub_patterns.root_cause: The default SSL context trusts all certificates without requiring an explicit insecure flag, disabling certificate validation.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Apply proper URL encoding to each parameter.
sub_patterns.name: URL parameter injection due to missing encoding
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled parameters are concatenated into a URL query string without URL encoding, allowing injection of additional parameters.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Validate credential JSON with a dedicated validator to reject dangerous constructs.
sub_patterns.name: Missing validation of credential source JSON
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-supplied credential JSON contains dangerous file/URL references that are passed to auth library without sanitization.

sub_patterns.name: Missing validation of user-provided URL targets in server-side network operations
